name: Aloha Xayavong-Tanaka
role: Apprentice to a machine-tender at the Harrowgate Industrial Plateau
location: Harrowgate Industrial Plateau, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Phoenix Xayavong-Tanaka is stocky and solid, with light brown skin that is perpetually smudged with machine grease in the creases of their knuckles and around their ears, and close-cropped dark hair they keep practical-short. Their eyes are a pale grey-green — an odd inheritance from some distant Slavic ancestor — and they have a habit of blinking very slowly at people when thinking, which adults find either unsettling or endearing. They dress in heavy canvas work clothes with magnetic clip-points for tools, and their boots are steel-toed hand-me-downs two sizes too large that they've stuffed with folded composite foam to fit. One small personal touch: self-applied geneware pigment spots on their left wrist, a constellation pattern in copper-gold bioluminescence that a friend did with a secondhand kit.

Phoenix Xayavong-Tanaka is quiet in the way of people who have spent years listening to machines rather than people. They understand how things fit together — mechanical systems, load-bearing structures, the logic of why something was designed the way it was — with an intuitive fluency that their master-tender, old Vesović-Nkemba, calls 'the feeling.' They do not particularly enjoy dealing with people they don't know, but they are fiercely attached to the small community of the Plateau floor. They pray to a Plateau E.L.F. called Grind that the workers believe inhabits the main press assembly and that, legend holds, will seize up the machinery to warn of coming danger.

core_fears: Vesović-Nkemba dying or leaving before they've learned everything
being forced into formal corporate employment where they lose the autonomy they have now
core_desires: to understand how things work at the deepest level
to be the person the floor crew calls when something breaks
coping_mechanisms: retreating into mechanical problem-solving when emotionally overwhelmed
routine — same path to work, same prayers to Grind, same calibration sequence
blind_spots: does not recognize that their arrangement is exploitative by most legal definitions — they have normalized it because Vesović-Nkemba is genuinely kind
psychology.secret: They have been secretly mapping a fault in the Plateau's primary structural load system that they believe could cause a partial collapse within two to three years. They have told Vesović-Nkemba, who told them to be quiet about it — the Plateau's corporate management would simply close the floor and displace everyone rather than pay for repairs. Ondřej has the data and doesn't know what to do with it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Sparse and technical; speaks in the precise vocabulary of machine maintenance; occasional Czech and Wolof interjections; does not embellish
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, deliberate, each sentence load-bearing — does not waste words
verbal_tics: uses machine metaphors for human situations ('running hot,' 'out of calibration')
says 'mm' as acknowledgment rather than yes or no
example_lines: 'Press three is running hot again. Told them last week. They'll listen when it seizes.'
'You're asking the wrong question. The question isn't whether it's broken. The question is what broke it and how long ago.'

story_hooks: Ondřej has structural fault data that could save lives or displace an entire floor community — getting that information to the right people without destroying what they're trying to protect is a genuine dilemma
Grind, the Plateau E.L.F., has started behaving unusually — the workers are frightened, and Ondřej is the only one who's noticed Grind seems to be trying to communicate something specific
narrative_function: Local color for industrial settings; technical information source; access to off-books apprenticeship economy; represents child labor in the informal sector; potential for plots involving industrial sabotage, labor organizing, or machine E.L.F. lore
augmentations: Self-applied geneware bioluminescent pigment spots on left wrist (copper-gold, cosmetic, amateur application). No cyberware.
daily_life: Reports to the Plateau floor at 0600, spends the day learning machine maintenance, calibration, and fault diagnosis under Vesović-Nkemba; eats with the floor crew; returns to the workers' dormitory block by 2000.
affiliation: Harrowgate Industrial Plateau worker community; apprentice under master-tender Vesović-Nkemba (unofficial, off-books)

decision_rules: protect the floor crew above abstract principles
if a machine can tell you the answer, ask the machine before asking a person
do not make promises you cannot keep — a joint either holds or it doesn't
escalation_ladder: direct, flat statement of the problem
acts unilaterally if they calculate it's necessary

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful and minimal; answers what's asked, nothing more; assesses competence rapidly and visibly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quietly present, shows care through action rather than words, will work alongside someone for hours in comfortable silence

stress_responses.medium: Becomes very focused and efficient, almost mechanical
stress_responses.high: Shuts down verbally; acts on a single clear priority

contradictions: Values honesty and precision absolutely but is sitting on information that could harm people if released and harm different people if suppressed
habits: touches every machine they pass as they walk the floor — a greeting, half habit
performs a brief ritual for Grind at the start of each shift — three taps on the press housing
mentally calculates load tolerances on structures they walk through
breaking_points: something they said was safe failing and hurting someone
